title: DaqiAPI March 2026 Update
excerpt: New billing dashboard, faster token generation and reliability improvements.

content.p: This month we shipped the new billing dashboard, sub-second token generation and a round of reliability improvements across the gateway.
We are working on usage-based alerts and an easier way to share tokens between team members. Feedback is welcome in the comments below.

faq.q: Is the new billing dashboard live for everyone?
faq.a: Yes, the billing dashboard is available on all accounts now.

faq.q: Does gateway failover affect my tokens?
faq.a: No. Your tokens keep working through the gateway even during maintenance windows.

faq.q: When does the usage export arrive?
faq.a: The usage CSV export is planned for next month.
